parameters.help_en:
The unique ID of the data asset table to which the columns belong in MaxCompute, ApsaraDB RDS, or other data assets.

Queries column data in data asset tables that are connected to and authorized by Data Security Center based on the table ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141709.html operation to obtain the table ID
parameters.help_zh:
MaxCompute、RDS等资产表中的列所属的资产表唯一标识ID。

根据资产表的ID查询数据安全中心连接授权的数据资产表中列的数据，资产表ID可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141709.html接口获取
parameters.name: table_id

parameters.help_en:
The unique ID of the sensitive data detection rule that the column data matches.

资产表中列数据命中的敏感数据识别规则的唯一标识ID。
